richiami.difetto: The brake pad could detach from its retaining clip and fall away from the brake disc
richiami.rimedio: Fit a 3mm spacer ring to the wheel before the brake disc to prevent the pad detaching
richiami.titolo: A FRONT BRAKE PAD MAY DISLODGE UNDER BRAKING
